description: Place an order. Two modes: (A) VIP wholesale: provide lineUserId of a registered VIP customer. (B) Guest retail: provide customerName, phone, items array, and a delivery address — shippingAddress, shippingProvince and email are all required, and an order missing any of them is rejected. Guest orders are priced at tier-linked retail rates (server-calculated) and the total is final at this point; a confirmation email with a PromptPay QR follows. Without customerKey or a personal token URL connection, every order creates a new customer with a new customerKey, even when the email was used before (orders are never linked to an existing customer by email); the new key is returned in the response and the confirmation email — tell the user to save it. Inventory is NOT deducted — orders go to the pick queue for staff fulfillment. Delivery is available within Thailand only, so the province must be a Thai one. International addresses are not accepted. (C) LINE VIP customer connected through a personal token URL (get_catalog says ordering is available in this chat): send vipItems only — one entry per item, with fishName, status and tier exactly as get_catalog shows them and the quantity in the form get_catalog gives for that item (bands, packs or kg). The server calculates prices, shipping and the total; the total is an estimate, billing is by invoice after picking, and no payment is taken now. Call with dryRun: true first, show the user the lines and the estimate, and place the order only after the user confirms.

customerKey.description: (Guest mode) Registered customer key (from register_customer). Resolves name/phone/shipping automatically. If you are connected through a personal token URL the customer is already resolved: send items[] alone and omit this, customerName, phone and lineUserId.

dryRun.description: (LINE VIP mode only) true = return the lines and the estimated total without placing the order

email.description: (Guest mode) Email address for the order confirmation — required for guest orders

status.description: Cut / preparation of the fish (e.g. "sashimi fillet"). Pass the status shown for this fish in get_catalog, verbatim. Optional: when omitted the server fills it in from stock, and asks which one if more than one cut is available.

lang.description: (Guest mode, optional) Language of the confirmation email. Defaults to en.

lineUserId.description: LINE user ID of VIP customer (VIP mode). Omit for guest mode.

shippingAddress.description: (Guest mode) Street address and building name — required for guest orders

shippingDistrict.description: (Guest mode) Hua Hin / Pranburi 等の地元配達判定に必須。住所に含まれていれば自動判定するが、明示推奨 / District name. Required to detect local (free) delivery for Hua Hin / Pranburi. Auto-detected from shippingAddress when present, but explicit value recommended.

shippingProvince.description: (Guest mode) Thai province name, used for shipping cost — required for guest orders. Thailand only.

vipItems.description: (LINE VIP mode only) Order lines for a LINE VIP customer connected through a personal token URL. Ignored in other modes.

bands.description: Packs per weight band, e.g. {"140-180g": 3} — only for items get_catalog marks as ordered by bands

kg.description: Kilograms in steps of 0.5, or exactly the stock shown — only for items ordered by kg

packs.description: Total packs — only for items ordered by packs

status.description: As shown in get_catalog for this item

tier.description: As shown in get_catalog (All for cooking, prepared and whole cooking items)
